alt: Open savanna plain with scattered acacia trees under a wide sky in the Serengeti
caption: Typical Serengeti scenery: open grass plains broken by acacia and kopjes. The southern end of this ecosystem around Ndutu is where the calving herds gather in February.

alt: View over the Ngorongoro Crater floor from the rim
caption: The 600 m deep Ngorongoro caldera seen from the rim. The group camps on the rim at about 2,300 m and descends at dawn for a six-hour drive on the crater floor.

alt: Wildebeest herd on the move across the Serengeti plain
caption: Wildebeest on the move in the Serengeti. In February the herds concentrate on the Ndutu plains to give birth, and the predators gather behind them.

alt: Large baobab tree in Tarangire National Park
caption: A baobab in Tarangire, the first park on the route. In February the park is in its green season, so elephants and other game are more dispersed than in the dry months.

location: Ol Doinyo Lengai, near Lake Natron
alt: Ol Doinyo Lengai volcano rising above the plain near Lake Natron
caption: Ol Doinyo Lengai, the active volcano climbed at night from the Natron side. It is the only volcano known to erupt natrocarbonatite lava.

alt: Flamingos on the shallow alkaline water of Lake Natron
caption: Flamingos on Lake Natron's alkaline shallows. Numbers vary with water level and season, so sightings in February are not guaranteed.

alt: Landscape at Lake Eyasi in the Rift Valley
caption: Lake Eyasi, the shallow Rift Valley lake where the Hadzabe and Datoga live. Visits go through the registered Lake Eyasi Cultural Tourism Programme.

alt: Main street of Mto wa Mbu with shops and pedestrians
caption: The main street of Mto wa Mbu, a market town at the foot of the Rift escarpment where the group camps and joins a village walk or bicycle tour.

alt: Olduvai Gorge dry valley with layered rock walls
caption: Olduvai Gorge, where the Leakey team found early human fossils. It is a stop on the way back from the Serengeti, with a small museum.
A leopard in the Seronera Valley. Central Serengeti is one of the best places in Africa to find them, and the public campsite sits in the same corridor.

alt: Engaruka landscape at the foot of the Rift escarpment
caption: Engaruka, site of pre-colonial stone-terraced irrigation fields, passed on the dirt road to Lake Natron.

alt: Mount Kilimanjaro rising above Moshi town
caption: Kilimanjaro rising above Moshi, near the arrival airport. A summit climb is not in the core route but the mountain is the first view on arrival on clear days.
